items.title: Giant Ender over a burning ruin
items.alt: A giant black Ender with glowing orange eyes stands over a burning ruin in a very tall strip.

items.title: Terrinia, the last bastion
items.alt: A walled island city lies under a hexagon shield with a beam of light rising from a tall tower.

items.title: Warriors in silhouette
items.alt: A girl with a long weapon stands in front of a crowd of faceless students in blue.

items.title: Roger runs
items.alt: Roger runs along a paved path past hedges and a building, looking back in fear.

items.title: Roger is thrown down
items.alt: Roger falls head first against a wall as a white burst strikes beside him.

items.title: Roger looks up
items.alt: Roger looks up, scared, as bright blades stab the ground beside him.

items.title: An AI droid reaches for Roger
items.alt: A silvery AI droid with electric claws looms over Roger, cut out on a transparent background.

items.title: A droid caught in a cable
items.alt: An AI droid with raised claws is wrapped in a glowing blue cable in a slanted panel.

items.title: Fanny slashes a droid
items.alt: Fanny slashes a droid with a blade of blue light while a large faded copy of her face fills the panel behind her.

items.title: Fanny drifts upside down
items.alt: Fanny, upside down, drifts with her winged blades spread, cut out on a transparent background.

items.title: AI droid, back view
items.alt: An AI droid with a round body and an orange glowing eye seen from behind, cut out on a transparent background.

items.title: Fanny turns in the air
items.alt: Fanny falls head first through the clouds with pale copies of her winged blades above her.

items.title: Fanny looks down in flight
items.alt: Fanny looks down with her hair over her eyes and a blade in her hand, with clouds behind her.

items.title: Fanny with her wings spread
items.alt: Fanny floats facing the viewer with her arms raised and her winged blades spread against a violet sky.

items.title: AI droid, front view
items.alt: A close view of the domed head and shoulders of an AI droid with an orange light, cut out on a transparent background.

items.title: A figure in the doorway
items.alt: A figure with long hair stands in a lit doorway of a tall building, seen from far below with a large shadow on the ground.

items.title: Roger, alarmed
items.alt: A close-up of Roger with blue eyes and a headset, mouth open in alarm, cut out on a transparent background.

items.title: Fanny thinks on the battlefield
items.alt: A close-up of Fanny with green eyes and a drop of sweat, cut out on a transparent background.

items.title: Layla raises her cannon
items.alt: Layla smiles with her long white cannon raised on one shoulder in a bright room.

items.title: Layla boasts
items.alt: A chibi Layla with closed eyes holds a hand to her chest while Fanny and Roger stand small beside her.

items.title: Layla and Fanny face to face
items.alt: Layla and Fanny glare at each other in a close-up with sparks between them.

items.title: Layla looks uneasy
items.alt: Layla raises a gloved hand with an uneasy look, cut out on a transparent background.

items.title: Fanny walks away
items.alt: Fanny walks away holding her head while Layla stands at the left and Roger crouches on cracked paving.

items.title: Fanny, Roger and Layla
items.alt: Fanny, Roger and Layla stand side by side facing forward, cut out on a transparent background.

items.title: The Selrick Academy tower
items.alt: The spire of Selrick Academy rises above a plaza at sunset.

items.title: A screen of battle scenes
items.alt: Students watch a huge wall screen that shows a grid of battle scenes.

items.title: Layla cheers, chibi
items.alt: A chibi Layla smiles with a fist at her cheek while a chibi Fanny stands beside her.

items.title: A hall of screens
items.alt: Layla and other students stand in a blue lit hall with balloons while screens show battles.

items.title: A scuffle, chibi style
items.alt: Chibi Layla with her big sword blushes between chibi Fanny, Roger and a girl with glasses.

items.title: Alarm in red
items.alt: Students run in red light as small round alarm drones fly around a huge dark shape in the background.

items.title: Red light at the Academy
items.alt: Layla and other students stand in red light while a figure in the foreground rushes away.

items.title: The shield cracks over Terrinia
items.alt: A hexagon shield cracks over the city as a dark craft falls from the sky and crowds look up.

items.title: A man before the ruins
items.alt: A man in a long dark coat and glasses stands in front of ruined buildings with his arms out, in a wide slanted panel.

items.title: Professor Joe shouts
items.alt: Professor Joe, in round glasses, shouts in a slanted panel with speed lines.

items.title: A blast throws debris
items.alt: A blast throws a figure and debris across a purple sky in a tall slanted panel.

items.title: Professor Joe and the toy rabbit
items.alt: Professor Joe kneels in armor and hands a pink toy rabbit to a small crying girl in red.

items.title: Looking at the red sky
items.alt: Two figures in the foreground look toward a burning red sky where two small figures stand in the distance.

items.title: Layla in anger
items.alt: Layla frowns with a vein mark on her forehead and holds her cannon while sparks of light drift around her.

items.title: Fanny, focused
items.alt: A close-up of Fanny with narrowed green eyes and red hair in a slanted panel.

items.title: Layla looks aside
items.alt: A tall close-up of Layla looking sideways with a firm mouth in a slanted panel.

items.title: Layla and Fanny rush in
items.alt: Layla aims her cannon as she and Fanny rush toward the viewer in a slanted panel with speed lines.

items.title: Layla and Fanny ready to fight
items.alt: Fanny hovers above Layla with both of them holding weapons and ribbons of blue light around them.

items.title: Fanny cuts down an Ender
items.alt: Fanny dashes through a streak of blue light below a large falling Ender.

items.title: Layla charges
items.alt: Layla rushes along a blue streak of light with her large sword drawn back in a slanted panel.

items.title: Layla in green light
items.alt: Layla looks surprised in a swirl of green light in a wide slanted panel.

items.title: A huge Ender in the city
items.alt: A huge horned Ender with a burning head claws through the towers of a city in a tall slanted panel.

items.title: Behind the falling rock
items.alt: Layla and Fanny crouch behind a slab of rock as stones break apart around them.

items.title: A small figure in flight
items.alt: A small figure with long pink hair flies along a blue trail beneath giant dark wings and floating rocks.

items.title: Layla fires while flying
items.alt: Layla and Fanny look shocked in a very tall strip while a pink star of light bursts at the bottom.

items.title: An Ender breaks apart
items.alt: An Ender breaks apart in lightning and green light as a golden core burns at its chest.

items.title: A vortex of dust and embers
items.alt: A huge brown vortex of dust and embers rises into a purple sky in a tall slanted panel.
items.note: This panel was cut from page 36 of The Aspirant. The art has no lettering.

items.title: A fireball falls on the city
items.alt: A fireball falls toward a ruined city seen from above in a wide slanted panel.
items.note: This panel was cut from page 36 of The Aspirant. The art has no lettering.

items.title: Ruins under smoke
items.alt: A wide strip of gray ruined city blocks under swirling smoke.
items.note: This panel was cut from page 36 of The Aspirant. The art has no lettering.

items.title: A broken tower at dusk
items.alt: Two tiny figures stand on the roof of a broken tower as dust and fire rise in the purple dusk.

items.title: Layla sits on a ledge
items.alt: Layla sits on a rooftop edge under a purple night sky with her cannon behind her, scuffed and calm.

items.title: Fanny spaces out
items.alt: Fanny in profile in front of a dusk city skyline with a blank look.

items.title: A star and an angry eye
items.alt: A wide strip with a small gold star in the dark sky and Layla's angry eye with a vein mark.

items.title: Fanny and Layla on the roof
items.alt: Fanny stands holding a blade and looking aside while Layla sits low in the right foreground at dusk.

items.title: Fanny stands, hand at her cheek
items.alt: Fanny stands with a hand at her cheek and her scuffed winged blades behind her, on a transparent background.

items.title: Layla looks back
items.alt: Layla looks back over her shoulder with a soft look under a night sky.

items.title: Layla smiles
items.alt: A narrow strip showing Layla's eye and a small smile as she lowers her head.

items.title: Two on the rooftop
items.alt: Layla and Fanny stand on a rooftop at night, seen from behind with their weapons.

items.title: Fanny after the fight
items.alt: A tall close-up of Fanny from the side with scratches on her cheek against a night sky.

items.title: Layla in tears
items.alt: A tall close-up of Layla with a teary eye, a small smile and dust on her cheek.

items.title: Layla and Fanny, night sky
items.alt: Layla and Fanny stand side by side with their weapons under a dark sky with two pale rings.

items.title: Terrinia burns
items.alt: Smoke and fire rise around a tall spire as explosions burst across the city.

items.title: Vexana kneels in the fire
items.alt: Vexana kneels in a burning landscape, hurt, with explosions behind her.

items.title: Hands around the emblem
items.alt: Vexana's hands hold a glowing gold emblem in front of her skirt.

items.title: Vexana cries
items.alt: Vexana's face half hidden by her hair with tears and dust on her cheek and flames behind her.

items.title: Vexana kneels in the ruins
items.alt: Vexana kneels among broken rocks under a fiery sky with her hands in her lap.

items.title: A spark in her hands
items.alt: Vexana's hands cup a spark of light at her lap.

items.title: Guinevere and Vexana fight Enders
items.alt: Guinevere and Vexana fight back to back against a swarm of Enders in a pink lit hall.

items.title: Vexana strikes
items.alt: Vexana swings a black armored arm in a slanted pink panel with speed lines.

items.title: Guinevere punches an Ender
items.alt: Guinevere punches an Ender's armored arm in a burst of pink light.

items.title: Guinevere dodges an Ender
items.alt: Guinevere leaps away from the swing of a huge Ender in a tall corridor.

items.title: A portal opens behind Guinevere
items.alt: Guinevere dashes forward as a dark portal opens behind her with an Ender's helmet inside it.

items.title: An Ender reaches for Guinevere
items.alt: A huge Ender claw reaches down toward Guinevere, who looks back in shock, in a tall slanted panel.

items.title: Vexana pushes Guinevere away
items.alt: A white gloved hand pushes Guinevere back with a burst of light at her chest in a slanted panel.

items.title: Vexana rushes past Guinevere
items.alt: Vexana runs forward with a white gloved fist while Guinevere stumbles back beside her in a tall slanted panel.

items.title: A hand reaches for Vexana
items.alt: Vexana is pulled into a black portal while a dark gloved hand reaches toward her.

items.title: Guinevere reaches out
items.alt: Guinevere's face fills a slanted panel as she stretches a red gloved hand toward the viewer.

items.title: Vexana in tears, smiling
items.alt: A close-up of Vexana smiling through tears, with wet violet eyes, in a slanted panel with speed lines.

items.title: Vexana fades from the wall
items.alt: Vexana's face tears out of a pale wall like paper, her eyes full of sadness.

items.title: Vexana falls into the dark
items.alt: Vexana falls head first through a starry void with her arms out.

items.title: The emblem lights up
items.alt: Vexana, upside down, cups her hands around a glowing gold emblem on her chest.

items.title: Vexana falls, eyes closed
items.alt: A close-up of Vexana falling upside down with her eyes closed as blue light rushes past.

items.title: Vexana falls in blue light
items.alt: Vexana falls upside down in a blue light with a hand on her chest.

items.title: Fireworks over the hill
items.alt: Guinevere and Vexana hold hands on a hill and look up at fireworks in a night sky.

items.title: Vexana, small in the void
items.alt: Vexana falls upside down in the dark, small in a slanted panel.

items.title: Honor for the best pair
items.alt: Vexana and Guinevere stand hand in hand in the sun while a teacher at the left edge and a cheering group look on.

items.title: Vexana falls in light
items.alt: Vexana falls upside down with her arms over her head as blue light streams past.

items.title: The bottom of the fall
items.alt: Vexana plunges down a tunnel of blue light into the dark, small at the foot of the strip.

items.title: The emblem, close up
items.alt: A gold star shaped emblem glows on Vexana's chest in a white and blue burst.

items.title: The emblem shines
items.alt: A blinding white and blue glow spreads from the Emblem of Hope in a wide panel.

items.title: A burst of blue light
items.alt: Black spikes frame a burst of blue light that grows brighter toward the bottom of a tall page.
items.note: This is all of page 29 of Guinevere and Vexana. The page has no lettering.

items.title: Resting under a tree
items.alt: Guinevere lies in Vexana's lap with her fists raised while Vexana rests a hand on her head, among grass and falling leaves.

items.title: Talking happily
items.alt: Vexana and Guinevere face each other under a bright blue sky with Guinevere holding a gold charm.

items.title: Reality cracks over Guinevere
items.alt: Guinevere sits laughing on a sunny hillside with her eyes closed while a black clawed shard splits the air above her.

items.title: The Mother Matrix
items.alt: A dark armored head with glowing purple eyes fills the panel.

items.title: Vexana in black smoke
items.alt: Vexana stands with her arms open in a dark mist with a worried look.

items.title: A violet eye
items.alt: A wide dark panel where one violet eye opens.

items.title: A closing eye
items.alt: A wide dark violet panel where an eye closes.

items.title: A step into the light
items.alt: A white armored boot steps into a pool of light in the dark.

items.title: A dark figure turns
items.alt: A figure in dark armor with purple spears stands at the edge of a white flash.

items.title: A red lit corridor
items.alt: An empty metal corridor lit in red fills a wide slanted panel.

items.title: Guinevere sees the Eternal Guard
items.alt: Guinevere watches a wall of screens that show glowing pink hearts beside a warning triangle.

items.title: Guinevere, shocked
items.alt: A close-up of Guinevere's wide red eyes and cat ear headset in a metal corridor.

items.title: An Eternal Guard's heart glows
items.alt: A pink heart shaped emblem pulses on an Eternal Guard's chest while a small figure stands before it.

items.title: Terrinia at night
items.alt: An aerial view of a city at night with a ring shaped tower rising above the river.

items.title: Figures on the rooftop
items.alt: Glowing purple figures stand on a rooftop under a night sky filled with dust.

items.title: Vexana in dark armor
items.alt: Vexana with pale hair and violet eyes in dark armor, expressionless, with spears behind her.

items.title: Vexana before the Eternal Guard
items.alt: A great armored giant looms behind Vexana with a violet heart glowing in its chest.

items.title: Guinevere in the corridor
items.alt: Guinevere stands in a pink lit corridor with a calm look, a cat ear headset and her hands at her collar.

items.title: Vexana and Guinevere, chibi
items.alt: A chibi Vexana holds a chibi Guinevere, who smiles and raises a hand, on a white page with soft pink light.
items.note: This is all of page 46 of Guinevere and Vexana. The page has no lettering.
